$schema_note: Base task cards for the AEVF Index. All ai_* fields are MODELED ASSUMPTIONS (spec section 18: 'modeled', not 'observed') representing a competent single-agent scaffold on a frontier model as of 2026-08. Prices merge in from data/prices.json (sourced research). Reliability priors are anchored to published evidence in data/reliability_evidence.json and are estimates, not measured trials.

tasks.name: Standard mutual NDA review
tasks.economic_output: Redline plus concise risk memo identifying material non-standard clauses
tasks.notes: Well-scoped, playbook-driven; closest analog to LawGeex-style studies.

tasks.name: Vendor / MSA contract review
tasks.economic_output: Issue list, redlines, and negotiation recommendations against playbook
tasks.notes: Longer, more bespoke than NDA; higher variance in acceptance.

tasks.name: Contract clause extraction and abstraction
tasks.economic_output: Structured abstract of key clauses, dates, obligations
tasks.notes: Extraction is the most deterministic legal task; strongest viability case.

tasks.name: Legal research memo
tasks.economic_output: Cited memo answering a defined legal question in one jurisdiction
tasks.notes: Citation reliability is the binding constraint (hallucination studies).

tasks.name: Standard incorporation / LLC formation package
tasks.economic_output: Complete formation document set for a standard entity
tasks.notes: Already commoditized by LegalZoom-class services; templates dominate.

tasks.name: Commercial lease abstraction
tasks.economic_output: Structured abstract: rent, term, options, obligations, critical dates
tasks.notes: Long documents but structured target; established outsourcing market to compare.

tasks.name: First-pass discovery document classification
tasks.economic_output: Responsive / not-responsive / privileged tags with rationale
tasks.notes: Volume task; TAR precedent means acceptance criteria are well established.

tasks.name: Privacy policy / terms of service draft
tasks.economic_output: Jurisdiction-appropriate policy tailored to the business
tasks.notes: Template-heavy; regulatory drift is the main risk term.

tasks.name: Monthly SMB bookkeeping and reconciliation
tasks.economic_output: Categorized ledger, reconciled accounts, month-end close package
tasks.notes: Reconciliation is self-checking; exceptions drive the review load.

tasks.name: AP invoice coding and categorization
tasks.economic_output: GL-coded, approval-routed invoices with exceptions flagged
tasks.notes: Mature OCR-plus-LLM category; per-invoice cost studies give clean human baseline.

tasks.name: 13-week cash-flow forecast (SMB)
tasks.economic_output: Rolling 13-week direct-method forecast with scenario notes
tasks.notes: Fractional-CFO staple; quality judged on assumptions, not arithmetic.

tasks.name: Monthly budget variance analysis
tasks.economic_output: Variance report with drivers, commentary, and flags
tasks.notes: Structured inputs, formulaic output; strong fit.

tasks.name: SMB business tax return preparation
tasks.economic_output: Complete, filing-ready business return (1120-S / 1065 class)
tasks.notes: Preparer liability and signature requirement keep humans in the loop; regulatory viability lags technical.

tasks.name: 3-statement financial model
tasks.economic_output: Linked 3-statement model with drivers and scenario toggles
tasks.notes: Spreadsheet agency remains brittle; balance-check gives partial self-verification.

tasks.name: Commercial credit memo
tasks.economic_output: Underwriting write-up: borrower profile, financial spread, risks, recommendation
tasks.notes: Directly relevant to AI-native lending; structured inputs, standardized format.

tasks.name: Expense report audit
tasks.economic_output: Policy-compliance review with violations flagged and documented
tasks.notes: Rule-checking against policy text; near-deterministic verification.

tasks.name: Isolated software bug fix with tests
tasks.economic_output: Merged fix passing existing and new tests
tasks.notes: Best-measured domain (SWE-bench class); tests give cheap verification.

tasks.name: Unit test suite generation
tasks.economic_output: Passing test suite with meaningful coverage of a module
tasks.notes: Self-verifying (tests run); main risk is vacuous coverage.

tasks.name: CRUD feature implementation
tasks.economic_output: Working end-to-end feature: schema, API, UI, tests
tasks.notes: The bread-and-butter agentic coding task in 2026.

tasks.name: Third-party API integration
tasks.economic_output: Working integration with auth, error handling, and tests
tasks.notes: External-dependency friction (docs drift, sandbox access) drives retries.

tasks.name: Frontend page from design spec
tasks.economic_output: Pixel-faithful responsive page implementing the spec
tasks.notes: Visual acceptance is subjective; screenshot loops raised reliability sharply in 2025-26.

tasks.name: Pull-request code review
tasks.economic_output: Substantive review: correctness findings, risks, suggestions
tasks.notes: Already deployed at scale (bot reviewers); false-positive noise is the cost driver.

tasks.name: Data migration script
tasks.economic_output: Verified migration with rollback plan and row-count checks
tasks.notes: Irreversibility raises the risk term; dry-run verification helps.

tasks.name: Production incident diagnosis / RCA
tasks.economic_output: Root-cause identification with evidence and remediation plan
tasks.notes: Open-world debugging under time pressure; hardest software task in the set.

tasks.name: Tier-1 support ticket resolution
tasks.economic_output: Resolved ticket without human escalation, CSAT-acceptable
tasks.notes: Production resolution rates are published (Fin/Decagon class); R here means full deflection.

tasks.name: Refund / chargeback adjudication
tasks.economic_output: Policy-consistent decision with documented rationale
tasks.notes: Policy-rule application; exception-based review is the natural mode.

tasks.name: SaaS customer onboarding sequence
tasks.economic_output: Configured account, imported data, trained user through first value
tasks.notes: Multi-session, tool-heavy; churn risk is the hidden cost.

tasks.name: Account recovery / verification case
tasks.economic_output: Identity-verified recovery completed within policy
tasks.notes: Adversarial setting (social engineering); security cost dominates.

tasks.name: Sales lead qualification and enrichment
tasks.economic_output: Scored, enriched, deduplicated lead list with fit rationale
tasks.notes: Tool/API cost (enrichment data) rivals inference cost here.

tasks.name: Knowledge-base article authoring
tasks.economic_output: Accurate, styled help-center article from product truth
tasks.notes: Low-risk drafting with product docs as ground truth.

tasks.name: Ad creative set (copy and concepts)
tasks.economic_output: Campaign-ready set of ad variants across placements
tasks.notes: Acceptance is taste-based; performance-based grading would be better but lags.

tasks.name: Landing page copywriting
tasks.economic_output: Conversion-oriented page copy matched to brand voice
tasks.notes: High-volume freelance market gives a clean price baseline.

tasks.name: SEO article (1,500-2,000 words)
tasks.economic_output: Publishable, factually sound long-form article targeting a keyword
tasks.notes: The most visibly price-compressed market in the whole set.

tasks.name: Email nurture sequence (5-7 emails)
tasks.economic_output: Segmented sequence with subject lines and CTAs
tasks.notes: Formulaic structure; brand-voice fit is the main rejection reason.

tasks.name: Campaign performance analysis
tasks.economic_output: Attribution-aware analysis with recommendations
tasks.notes: Data-in, narrative-out; errors are usually interpretation, not arithmetic.

tasks.name: Market research memo
tasks.economic_output: Sized, sourced market overview answering defined questions
tasks.notes: Deep-research products made this the flagship consumer-visible task of 2025-26.

tasks.name: Prior authorization packet preparation
tasks.economic_output: Complete, payer-conformant PA submission with clinical documentation attached
tasks.notes: CAQH gives an unusually clean per-transaction human cost baseline.

tasks.name: Medical coding support
tasks.economic_output: ICD-10 / CPT codes assigned with documentation linkage
tasks.notes: Compliance risk (upcoding/downcoding) keeps audit review mandatory.

tasks.name: Insurance claim documentation
tasks.economic_output: Complete claim submission with supporting documentation
tasks.notes: Denial-rate feedback provides outcome-based verification.

tasks.name: Patient chart summarization
tasks.economic_output: Chronological medical summary with sourced citations to the record
tasks.notes: Large legal-medical review market (IME, med-mal) with per-chart pricing.

tasks.name: Literature review
tasks.economic_output: Structured synthesis of relevant literature with accurate citations
tasks.notes: Citation integrity and coverage completeness are the failure modes.

tasks.name: Competitive landscape analysis
tasks.economic_output: Mapped competitor set with positioning, pricing, and feature comparison
tasks.notes: Web-verifiable facts; staleness is the main defect class.

tasks.name: Industry analysis memo
tasks.economic_output: Thesis-driven industry memo with sized claims and sources
tasks.notes: Analyst-associate class work; judgment quality is the differentiator.

tasks.name: Ad-hoc spreadsheet / data analysis
tasks.economic_output: Correct analysis answering defined questions, with workings shown
tasks.notes: Code-execution scaffolds make arithmetic reliable; framing errors remain.

tasks.name: Structured data extraction from documents
tasks.economic_output: Clean structured dataset extracted to schema, with QA flags
tasks.notes: Most fully-crossed task in the set; competes with offshore data entry.

tasks.name: Long-document summarization with citations
tasks.economic_output: Faithful summary with page-level citations (deposition/report class)
tasks.notes: Deposition-summary services provide a clean per-page human price.

tasks.name: Resume screening and shortlist
tasks.economic_output: Ranked shortlist with rubric-based rationale per candidate
tasks.notes: Bias/compliance exposure (EEOC, NYC LL144) adds regulatory risk term.

tasks.name: Job description drafting
tasks.economic_output: Role-accurate, compliant, on-brand job description
tasks.notes: Near-trivial for current models; review is brand fit only.

tasks.name: Business document translation
tasks.economic_output: Publication-grade translation between major language pairs
tasks.notes: MTPE (machine translation post-editing) is already the industry-standard workflow; the frontier crossed years ago for major pairs.

tasks.name: Meeting transcription summary and minutes
tasks.economic_output: Accurate minutes with decisions, owners, and action items
tasks.notes: Fully commoditized; included as a crossed-frontier anchor point.

tasks.name: FNOL claims intake and triage
tasks.economic_output: Structured first-notice-of-loss records, severity-triaged and routed with coverage flags
tasks.notes: Intake and routing is classification-shaped; leakage risk carries the exception review.

tasks.name: Commercial insurance quote package
tasks.economic_output: Complete broker submission: applications, loss runs summarized, market-ready package
tasks.notes: Broker back-office staple; E&O exposure keeps producer sign-off.

tasks.name: Policy review and coverage gap analysis
tasks.economic_output: Coverage summary with gaps, exclusions, and recommendation memo
tasks.notes: Long-document extraction plus judgment; kin to lease abstraction with higher stakes.

tasks.name: Auto damage estimate review
tasks.economic_output: Estimate audit: line-item reasonableness, supplement flags, settlement recommendation
tasks.notes: Vision-heavy; photo-based estimating is already production practice in carriers.

tasks.name: Underwriting submission intake
tasks.economic_output: Extracted, normalized submission data keyed to underwriting systems with completeness flags
tasks.notes: Document extraction at volume; strongest insurance fit.

tasks.name: KYC / AML customer review
tasks.economic_output: Completed due-diligence files: identity, screening hits dispositioned, risk-rated
tasks.notes: Screening-data vendor costs rival inference; regulatory exposure keeps QA mandatory.

tasks.name: Contract obligation compliance audit
tasks.economic_output: Obligation register with breach flags and renewal/notice calendar
tasks.notes: Extraction at volume against defined obligations; CLM vendors already sell this.

tasks.name: DSAR fulfillment
tasks.economic_output: Complete, redacted subject-access response package within statutory scope
tasks.notes: Search-collect-redact pipeline; over-disclosure is the expensive failure mode.

tasks.name: Corporate policy document draft
tasks.economic_output: Company-tailored internal policy aligned to framework requirements
tasks.notes: Template-heavy drafting against SOC 2 / ISO control language.

tasks.name: Trademark clearance search and opinion
tasks.economic_output: Knockout plus comprehensive search summary with registrability opinion
tasks.notes: Likelihood-of-confusion judgment is the hard part; search retrieval is easy.

tasks.name: Immigration petition package prep
tasks.economic_output: Assembled petition forms and exhibits, attorney-ready
tasks.notes: Form assembly is structured; consequences of error are severe, floor is high.

tasks.name: Demand letter drafting
tasks.economic_output: Fact-grounded demand letter with legal basis and settlement posture
tasks.notes: Formulaic genre with attorney sign-off; consumer tools already ship this.

tasks.name: Listing description and marketing package
tasks.economic_output: MLS description, feature copy, social captions, flyer text
tasks.notes: Fair-housing wording is the one real constraint; already widely AI-drafted.

tasks.name: Comparative market analysis
tasks.economic_output: Comp selection, adjustments, and price recommendation with rationale
tasks.notes: Data access (MLS) is the gating input, not the analysis.

tasks.name: Title search abstract
tasks.economic_output: Chain of title, liens, encumbrances, and exceptions abstracted from records
tasks.notes: Record fragmentation across counties is the practical constraint; misses are insured losses.

tasks.name: Tenant communications and maintenance triage
tasks.economic_output: Responses, vendor dispatch, and status tracking across tenant requests
tasks.notes: Support-shaped workload with dispatch decisions; habitability issues escalate.

tasks.name: 1:1 academic tutoring session
tasks.economic_output: An hour of adaptive instruction the learner (or parent) accepts as effective
tasks.notes: AI tutoring products already price this near zero; engagement, not knowledge, is the binding constraint.

tasks.name: Course module development
tasks.economic_output: Complete e-learning module: outline, content, activities, assessment
tasks.notes: Instructional-design benchmarks put 40-200 human hours per finished hour; huge compression surface.

tasks.name: Essay grading with rubric feedback
tasks.economic_output: Rubric-scored essays with individualized written feedback
tasks.notes: Automated essay scoring has decades of validity literature; feedback quality is the newer capability.

tasks.name: Assessment and quiz generation
tasks.economic_output: Aligned question set with keys, distractor rationale, difficulty spread
tasks.notes: Well-scoped generation against provided material.

tasks.name: Personalized outbound sequences
tasks.economic_output: Researched, personalized multi-touch sequences per prospect
tasks.notes: Reply-rate outcomes would be the honest grader; acceptance here means send-ready quality.

tasks.name: Sales proposal / RFP response draft
tasks.economic_output: Compliant, tailored response draft against requirements matrix
tasks.notes: Requirements-compliance checking is mechanical; win themes still human.

tasks.name: CRM cleanup and enrichment
tasks.economic_output: Deduplicated, normalized, enriched records with change log
tasks.notes: Deterministic verification; enrichment-data cost rivals inference.

tasks.name: Call summarization and CRM logging
tasks.economic_output: Structured call notes, next steps, and fields logged to CRM
tasks.notes: Fully commoditized by conversation-intelligence tools; crossed anchor point.

tasks.name: Freight quoting and booking
tasks.economic_output: Rated, margin-checked quotes with carrier booking on acceptance
tasks.notes: Brokerage back office; rate-API access is the tool cost.

tasks.name: Purchase order processing
tasks.economic_output: Validated, matched, system-entered purchase orders with exceptions flagged
tasks.notes: Three-way-match logic; APQC benchmarks give clean human baseline.

tasks.name: Vendor onboarding and verification
tasks.economic_output: Verified vendor file: tax forms, banking, insurance certs, risk screening
tasks.notes: Fraud (bank-detail swaps) drives the risk term.

tasks.name: Demand and inventory forecast
tasks.economic_output: SKU-level demand forecast with reorder recommendations and assumptions stated
tasks.notes: Forecast accuracy is outcome-graded with a lag; acceptance here is methodological soundness.

tasks.name: Logo concept set
tasks.economic_output: 3-5 distinct concepts with rationale and revision round
tasks.notes: Taste-based acceptance; vector-quality output still gates full substitution.

tasks.name: Social content pack (30 posts)
tasks.economic_output: Calendar of 30 posts: copy, hashtags, creative direction per platform
tasks.notes: Brand-voice fit drives rejections; volume production is trivial.

tasks.name: Podcast episode edit and show notes
tasks.economic_output: Cleaned audio edit plan, chapters, show notes, clips list
tasks.notes: AI audio tooling already does the heavy lift; notes and clips are text-native.

tasks.name: Video script (explainer / YouTube)
tasks.economic_output: Production-ready script with hook, structure, and B-roll notes
tasks.notes: Adjacent to landing-page copy in market structure.

tasks.name: Slide deck design (20 slides)
tasks.economic_output: Structured, styled 20-slide deck from source content
tasks.notes: Narrative structuring is strong; pixel-level design polish still gates the high end.

tasks.name: Codebase documentation
tasks.economic_output: Accurate API docs, architecture notes, and usage examples for a module set
tasks.notes: Reads the code directly; staleness, the human failure mode, disappears.

tasks.name: SQL / BI report build
tasks.economic_output: Correct query set and dashboard answering defined business questions
tasks.notes: Schema comprehension plus text-to-SQL; silent semantic errors are the risk.

tasks.name: ETL pipeline build (simple)
tasks.economic_output: Scheduled, monitored pipeline moving validated data between systems
tasks.notes: Environment access and silent data corruption keep the floor high.

tasks.name: Vulnerability alert triage
tasks.economic_output: Alerts dispositioned: exploitability, reachability, priority, fix suggestion
tasks.notes: False-negative cost is asymmetric; exception review is the deployment pattern.

tasks.name: Software UI localization
tasks.economic_output: Context-aware translated UI strings with length and placeholder constraints kept
tasks.notes: MTPE workflow is already the industry standard here; kin to the translation row.

tasks.name: Scheduling and calendar coordination
tasks.economic_output: Meetings scheduled across constraints with confirmations and reschedules handled
tasks.notes: The original agent demo task; calendar-API access is the whole game.

tasks.name: Business trip planning and booking
tasks.economic_output: Booked itinerary within policy: flights, hotel, ground, calendar holds
tasks.notes: Booking-system access and preference nuance keep humans in the loop.

tasks.name: Inbox triage and reply drafting
tasks.economic_output: Prioritized inbox with drafts staged and routine threads resolved
tasks.notes: Send-on-behalf is the trust threshold; drafts-only mode is standard.

tasks.name: Expense report preparation
tasks.economic_output: Receipts matched, categorized, policy-checked reports filed for approval
tasks.notes: Complement to the expense-audit row: the filing side of the same pipeline.

tasks.name: Payroll run processing (50 employees)
tasks.economic_output: Accurate, on-time payroll run: hours validated, exceptions resolved, filings queued
tasks.notes: A 0.99 floor: payroll errors are trust-destroying; software already does the math, exceptions are the work.

tasks.name: AR collections outreach
tasks.economic_output: Compliant dunning sequences, payment plans negotiated within policy, notes logged
tasks.notes: B2B first-party outreach; tone and compliance boundaries are the review target.

tasks.name: Annual budget preparation (SMB)
tasks.economic_output: Driver-based annual budget with department detail and board summary
tasks.notes: Kin to cash-flow forecast; assumptions quality is the acceptance bar.

tasks.name: Patient intake and registration
tasks.economic_output: Complete registrations: demographics, insurance capture, consents, chart setup
tasks.notes: Registration errors cascade into denials; upstream twin of the claims rows.

tasks.name: Insurance eligibility verification
tasks.economic_output: Coverage, benefits, and authorization requirements confirmed and documented
tasks.notes: CAQH prices this transaction directly; the cleanest healthcare baseline after PA.

tasks.name: Press release writing
tasks.economic_output: Newsroom-ready release with quotes, boilerplate, and distribution notes
tasks.notes: Rigid genre conventions favor generation; approval risk is quote accuracy.

tasks.name: Grant proposal drafting
tasks.economic_output: Complete narrative, budget justification, and compliance sections against RFP
tasks.notes: Win-rate is the true grader; acceptance here is submission-ready compliance and quality.

tasks.name: User manual / technical documentation
tasks.economic_output: Complete, accurate user documentation with procedures and screenshots plan
tasks.notes: Product access for verification is the practical constraint.

tasks.name: SBA 7(a) loan application package
tasks.economic_output: Lender-ready 7(a) package: SBA forms, three years of financials and tax returns, debt schedule, projections and narrative assembled and cross-checked; accepted when the lender submits without a document callback
tasks.notes: Packager fees are SBA-regulated (Form 159 disclosure, $2,500 flat alternative); chasing documents from the borrower is the elapsed-time constraint, not assembly.

tasks.name: Bank-statement cash-flow spread
tasks.economic_output: Twelve months of statements spread into deposits, NSF and overdraft counts, revenue trend, recurring debt payments and existing advances with anomaly flags; accepted when an underwriter can decision from it without re-reading statements
tasks.notes: Already heavily automated by OCR vendors (Ocrolus, Inscribe), so the human price overstates durable willingness to pay; altered statements are the residual failure mode.

tasks.name: MCA offer decode and true-cost summary
tasks.economic_output: Factor rate converted to true APR and IRR, fee and prepayment terms, stacking and confession-of-judgment red flags, and a plain-English summary the merchant can act on; accepted when figures reconcile to the contract
tasks.notes: No discrete human SKU; brokers do it free and attorneys bundle it into $2,500+ workouts, so the priced unit is thin and free AI decoders already exist.

tasks.name: Commercial loan closing set review
tasks.economic_output: Loan agreement, security agreement and guaranty checked clause by clause against the term sheet with a discrepancy schedule and redline requests; accepted when counsel signs the issues list
tasks.notes: Kin to vendor-contract-review with a term-sheet oracle; legal sign-off stays gated, and a missed cross-default or guaranty-scope clause is the liability mode.

tasks.name: Quarterly covenant compliance test
tasks.economic_output: Leverage, DSCR, fixed-charge and liquidity covenants computed from borrower financials per credit-agreement definitions, reconciled to the compliance certificate, with breach and cushion flags; accepted when the portfolio manager files it
tasks.notes: Definition-driven arithmetic (EBITDA add-backs) is where errors hide; covenant software vendors already sell this, compressing the human price.

tasks.name: Mortgage file document verification
tasks.economic_output: Income, asset and identity documents verified against the 1003 (names, dates, amounts, employment gaps, large deposits) with a conditions list; accepted when underwriting receives the file without a document-level condition
tasks.notes: Contract processors charge per closed file and absorb fallout; the doc check is roughly the front half of processing, and GSE income and asset tools already compress it.

tasks.name: Chargeback representment package
tasks.economic_output: Reason-code-matched evidence bundle (order, delivery, AVS and CVV, customer comms, policy) plus rebuttal letter submitted inside the network window; accepted on submission, paid on reversal
tasks.notes: Vendors price at 20-25% of recovered funds, so the human price already reflects heavy automation; win rate, not acceptance, is the buyer's KPI.

tasks.name: Comprehensive financial plan draft
tasks.economic_output: Goals, cash flow, net worth, retirement projection, insurance and estate gap analysis and recommendations, formatted for CFP review; accepted when the planner presents it with edits only
tasks.notes: Fiduciary delivery and the client conversation stay with the CFP; projection engines (eMoney, RightCapital) already do the math, the AI adds narrative and gap-finding.

tasks.name: Investment policy statement draft
tasks.economic_output: Objectives, risk tolerance, return targets, asset-allocation ranges, rebalancing rules, permitted investments, benchmarks and governance roles drafted from a client or committee questionnaire; accepted when the advisor or committee adopts it with minor edits
tasks.notes: Template-heavy and usually bundled free into AUM relationships, so the standalone price is a derived shadow price; nonprofit committees are the paying segment.

tasks.name: Portfolio rebalancing proposal
tasks.economic_output: Drift-versus-target analysis, proposed trade list, tax-lot selection with estimated realized gains and wash-sale checks, and a client-ready rationale; accepted when the advisor approves the trades as proposed
tasks.notes: Rebalancing engines (Orion Eclipse, iRebal) already automate the arithmetic; the priced unit is the advisor-reviewed proposal, and execution stays gated by suitability.

tasks.name: Earnings-call and 10-K advisor brief
tasks.economic_output: Two-page brief: key metrics versus prior period and consensus, guidance changes, management tone, risk-factor changes and client talking points; accepted when the advisor uses it without re-reading the filing
tasks.notes: AI supply has already collapsed this market ($2-$3 per report subscriptions), so the derived human price overstates durable willingness to pay; a hallucinated figure is the failure mode.

tasks.name: Fund due-diligence memo
tasks.economic_output: Manager background, strategy and edge, fee terms, performance attribution and peer comparison, operational and counterparty risk review from DDQ, PPM, audited financials and Form ADV, with a recommendation; accepted when the investment committee relies on it
tasks.notes: Onsite visits, reference calls and background checks cannot be done from documents, so AI covers the desk-review half; Madoff-type fraud is exactly what document review misses.

tasks.name: Client review meeting prep pack
tasks.economic_output: Performance commentary, since-last-meeting changes, open action items, agenda and talking points pulled from CRM, custodian and planning data; accepted when the advisor walks into the meeting with it unedited
tasks.notes: Paraplanner labor with no US per-unit SKU; UK outsourced paraplanning prices annual-review documentation at 75-150 GBP, the nearest observed analog.

tasks.name: Multi-state monthly sales tax return filing (5 states)
tasks.economic_output: Five state sales tax returns prepared, reconciled to the sales ledger and submitted on time with payment scheduled; accepted when each return ties to reported sales and no notice follows
tasks.notes: Software already automates the arithmetic; nexus judgment, portal logins and preparer accountability keep a human on the submit button.

tasks.name: Year-end 1099-NEC preparation and filing (50 contractors)
tasks.economic_output: Fifty 1099-NEC forms built from the vendor master and payment ledger, TIN-matched, e-filed with the IRS and delivered to recipients; accepted when totals tie to 1099-eligible payments and no B-notices follow
tasks.notes: Vendor-master to 1099 mapping is checkable; W-9 chasing and TIN mismatches drive the residual human work.

tasks.name: Audit workpaper preparation for one balance-sheet area
tasks.economic_output: PBC schedules, tie-outs to the trial balance and a lead sheet for one balance-sheet area (cash, AR, fixed assets, accruals) ready for the external auditor; accepted when the auditor raises no open items on the package
tasks.notes: Tie-outs are checkable but PBC schedules must satisfy an external auditor; documentation gaps trigger rework, not rejection.

tasks.name: Fixed-asset register and depreciation schedule maintenance
tasks.economic_output: Updated fixed-asset register with additions, disposals and transfers booked, book and tax depreciation computed, and roll-forward reconciled to the GL; accepted when the roll-forward ties and capitalization calls survive review
tasks.notes: Depreciation math is deterministic; capitalization policy calls and disposal tracing are where errors hide.

tasks.name: Month-end close package with flux commentary and board financials
tasks.economic_output: Accruals and deferrals booked, balance sheet reconciled, variance (flux) commentary written and a board-ready financial package issued; accepted when the controller signs off without reopening the period
tasks.notes: Extends bookkeeping-reconciliation upward: accrual judgment and narrative flux commentary are the acceptance bar, not the reconciliations.

tasks.name: R&D tax credit study with substantiation memo
tasks.economic_output: Qualifying-activity analysis under the four-part test, wage and expense allocation to QREs, Form 6765 support and a substantiation memo; accepted when the signing CPA adopts the credit figure without material adjustment
tasks.notes: Section 41 judgment and IRS scrutiny of Form 6765 detail keep a CPA signing; contingent-fee pricing means AI compresses fees fast.

tasks.name: RFP drafting for a mid-size purchase
tasks.economic_output: Issue-ready RFP with scope and requirements, weighted evaluation criteria, submission instructions, timeline and commercial terms; accepted when procurement releases it to vendors with only minor edits
tasks.notes: Requirements elicitation is the human part; the document itself is templated and AI-friendly.

tasks.name: Bid tabulation and vendor recommendation
tasks.economic_output: Scored bid matrix against the published criteria, pricing normalized to a common basis, and a written award recommendation; accepted when the evaluation committee adopts the ranking without rescoring
tasks.notes: Scoring against published criteria is checkable; price normalization across non-comparable bid structures is the error source.

tasks.name: Supplier risk assessment scorecard
tasks.economic_output: Scorecard covering financial health, cyber posture, ESG flags and sanctions screening with an overall risk tier and mitigation notes; accepted when the risk owner approves the tier without re-running the screen
tasks.notes: Data-vendor APIs supply the inputs; the scorecard is synthesis, and sanctions false negatives carry the tail risk.

tasks.name: Contract renewal analysis and negotiation brief
tasks.economic_output: Usage versus entitlement reconciliation, price benchmark against market, and a negotiation brief with target price, walk-away and levers; accepted when the buyer takes the brief into the vendor call as-is
tasks.notes: Usage-vs-entitlement math is deterministic; price benchmarks are the paid input and the brief is advisory, so acceptance is lenient.

tasks.name: Spend analysis and categorization (10,000 transactions)
tasks.economic_output: Ten thousand AP transactions cleansed, normalized by supplier and classified to a category taxonomy, with a spend cube and ranked savings opportunities; accepted when sampled classifications exceed 95 percent accuracy and the opportunity list is actionable
tasks.notes: Classification to a UNSPSC-style taxonomy is high-volume and checkable by sampling; the savings narrative is the judgment layer.

tasks.name: Purchase requisition review and PO creation
tasks.economic_output: One hundred requisitions checked against purchasing policy and budget, routed to the right approver, and converted to system POs with exceptions flagged; accepted when POs issue without downstream correction
tasks.notes: Policy and budget checks are rule-based; kin to po-processing but upstream, with approval routing as the workflow-integration gate.

tasks.name: Controlled SOP from process notes
tasks.economic_output: Controlled standard operating procedure (scope, roles, steps, safety, records) drafted from process notes and interview or video transcripts, accepted when document control approves it for release.
tasks.notes: Document-control sign-off stays human; transcription of video and interviews is the input cost, regulated sites (ISO 13485, GMP) raise stakes.

tasks.name: NCR root-cause analysis (8D or 5-Why report)
tasks.economic_output: Completed 8D or 5-Why report for one nonconformance: problem statement, containment, verified root cause, corrective and preventive actions, accepted when the quality manager and customer close the NCR.
tasks.notes: Root cause needs physical evidence and team input; AI drafts the D2-D7 structure and hypotheses but cannot run containment or verify the fix.

tasks.name: BOM validation and costing
tasks.economic_output: Validated bill of materials checked against drawings and supplier pricing, with rolled-up cost, flagged errors (missing parts, wrong quantities, obsolete or unpriced items), accepted when engineering signs the BOM release.
tasks.notes: Arithmetic and part-number checks are deterministic; drawing cross-reference is vision-heavy; supplier price lookups are the tool cost.

tasks.name: Process FMEA draft
tasks.economic_output: AIAG-VDA style PFMEA for one production process: failure modes, effects, causes, severity, occurrence, detection, action priority or RPN, recommended actions, accepted when the cross-functional team ratifies it.
tasks.notes: Tabular output is checkable; occurrence and detection ratings need plant knowledge, team ratification is the acceptance gate.

tasks.name: Maintenance log analysis and PM schedule recommendation
tasks.economic_output: Monthly analysis of CMMS work-order history for an asset fleet: failure patterns, bad actors, and revised preventive-maintenance intervals with rationale, accepted when the reliability lead adopts the schedule changes.
tasks.notes: CMMS free-text quality is the bottleneck; recommendations are advisory and the outcome (downtime, cost) shows over months.

tasks.name: Supplier quality audit report
tasks.economic_output: Audit report drafted from a completed checklist and evidence pack: graded findings with cited evidence, CAPA requests, and supplier status recommendation, accepted when the lead auditor signs and issues it.
tasks.notes: On-site evidence collection stays human; report drafting is the substitutable slice and is priced as such, lead auditor signs.

tasks.name: Quantity takeoff and cost estimate (small commercial)
tasks.economic_output: Multi-trade quantity takeoff from plan sheets with unit-priced cost estimate for a small commercial job, accepted when the estimator adopts it for a bid.
tasks.notes: Offshore takeoff services already compress price; vision accuracy on plan sheets is the reliability limiter.

tasks.name: RFI response draft
tasks.economic_output: Proposed response to a contractor RFI interpreting drawings and specifications, citing sheets and spec sections, flagging cost or schedule impact, accepted when the architect or engineer of record issues it with minor edits.
tasks.notes: Architect of record must issue the response; drafting from drawings and specs is the substitutable slice, design liability stays with the licensee.

tasks.name: Building permit application package
tasks.economic_output: Complete permit submission package: jurisdiction forms, code summary, drawings index, and required attachments checklist, accepted when the building department deems it complete for plan review.
tasks.notes: Expediter fee bundles agency follow-up and inspection scheduling; the AI slice is package assembly and code summary, jurisdiction rules vary.

tasks.name: Submittal review against specifications
tasks.economic_output: Review of product data or shop drawings against the specification section with a recommended action (approved, revise and resubmit, rejected) and itemized comments, accepted when the architect stamps it.
tasks.notes: Spec-compliance check is narrow and checkable; shop-drawing dimensional review is vision-heavy; architect stamps the action.

tasks.name: Construction schedule update and delay narrative
tasks.economic_output: Monthly CPM schedule update from progress reports with a written narrative of critical-path changes, delays, causes, and recovery plan, accepted when the owner's representative accepts the update.
tasks.notes: Schedule logic edits need P6 or MSP agency; narrative quality depends on progress-report completeness; delay narratives feed claims and are legally sensitive.

tasks.name: Change-order pricing and justification
tasks.economic_output: Change-order proposal: scope description, itemized cost breakdown (labor, material, equipment, sub quotes, markup), schedule impact, and contractual justification, accepted when the owner or architect approves it without material revision.
tasks.notes: Pricing needs current subcontractor quotes and contract markup terms; owner acceptance is the real grader.

tasks.name: FOIA / public-records request processing
tasks.economic_output: Search log, responsive record set with exemption-coded redactions, and a signed response letter ready for release
tasks.notes: Exemption calls (b)(5), (b)(6), (b)(7) are judgment-heavy; release decision stays with a FOIA officer.

tasks.name: Public-comment theme analysis for a rulemaking or council item
tasks.economic_output: Coded theme taxonomy, frequency table, representative quotes, and a summary memo covering roughly 1,000 comments
tasks.notes: Already sold as AI-assisted service (ICF CommentWorks, Future Fox); per-comment prices are compressing.

tasks.name: Federal grant compliance and performance report
tasks.economic_output: SF-425 style financial report reconciled to the ledger plus performance narrative against approved objectives, ready for authorized-official certification
tasks.notes: Financial figures must tie to GL and drawdowns; certification by an authorized official is required.

tasks.name: Benefits eligibility determination (SNAP/Medicaid-style case review)
tasks.economic_output: Verified case file, budget computation, eligibility recommendation, and notice text that a caseworker can approve without rework
tasks.notes: Federal rules require state merit-staff determination and an interview; AI is limited to case preparation and recommendation.

tasks.name: Government procurement solicitation draft (RFQ/IFB)
tasks.economic_output: Complete solicitation package with SOW, evaluation criteria, and correctly selected FAR-style clauses, ready for contracting-officer review
tasks.notes: Clause selection is checkable against FAR matrices; contracting-officer signature is the legal gate.

tasks.name: Legislative bill summary and fiscal note
tasks.economic_output: Plain-language summary of the bill plus a multi-year cost and revenue estimate with stated assumptions and data sources
tasks.notes: Summary is strong; the cost estimate depends on agency data requests that nonpartisan staff still have to run.

tasks.name: Donor acknowledgement and stewardship letters
tasks.economic_output: 100 personalized thank-you letters carrying IRS-compliant substantiation language (amount, date, goods-or-services statement), mail-ready
tasks.notes: IRS Pub 1771 language is checkable; print and postage are a separate pass-through cost.

tasks.name: Grant progress report to a funder
tasks.economic_output: Outcomes narrative against stated objectives with budget-to-actual table and variance explanations in the funder's template
tasks.notes: Template-driven; quality hinges on program data the org supplies.

tasks.name: Major-donor prospect research profile
tasks.economic_output: Profile covering capacity indicators, affinity, giving history, relationships, and a suggested ask range, with cited sources
tasks.notes: Entity disambiguation and unverifiable wealth claims are the failure mode; paid data feeds gate quality.

tasks.name: Nonprofit annual report draft
tasks.economic_output: Full narrative, program highlights, donor lists, and financial summary text for a 16-24 page annual report, ready for layout
tasks.notes: Price includes writing and design; AI output covers copy and charts data, layout stays with a designer.

tasks.name: Commercial utility bill audit
tasks.economic_output: Tariff-fit check on 12 months of bills, itemized billing errors, and a refund claim package the utility will accept
tasks.notes: Market prices on contingency (25-40% of recovery), so the human price is an implied fee on typical findings.

tasks.name: Distributed-generation interconnection application package (solar)
tasks.economic_output: Complete utility interconnection application with equipment specs, one-line reference, and net-metering elections submitted through the utility portal without rejection
tasks.notes: Utility acceptance is the grader; PE-stamped single-line diagram and utility fees are separate.

tasks.name: ASHRAE Level 1 style energy audit report
tasks.economic_output: Benchmarked EUI, utility-bill analysis, prioritized low-cost ECM list with order-of-magnitude savings, and a written report from utility data plus site notes
tasks.notes: Site walk-through remains human; AI covers benchmarking, bill analysis, and ECM drafting.

tasks.name: Marketplace product listing optimization
tasks.economic_output: Optimized title, bullets, backend keywords, and A+ copy for one Amazon-style listing, accepted when it passes marketplace style rules and the seller's brand review
tasks.notes: Already heavily AI-supplied; keyword tool access is the tool cost, marketplace compliance is the main reject reason.

tasks.name: Bulk product description writing (100-SKU catalog)
tasks.economic_output: Publishable, spec-accurate descriptions for 100 SKUs in a consistent brand voice, accepted after editor spot-check
tasks.notes: Spec sheets are the input; hallucinated attributes are the failure mode. Market price already compressed by AI tools.

tasks.name: Catalog attribute normalization and enrichment
tasks.economic_output: Supplier feed mapped to the retailer taxonomy with required attributes filled and validated, accepted when the feed passes schema and QA sampling
tasks.notes: Schema validation makes most errors checkable; wrong attribute values break filters and drive returns.

tasks.name: Customer review response management (100 public reviews)
tasks.economic_output: Brand-voice public replies to 100 product and seller reviews across platforms with escalation flags, accepted after brand manager review
tasks.notes: Public misstatements about product claims or refunds are the liability; per-response pricing is being compressed by AI reply tools.

tasks.name: Returns and warranty claim adjudication
tasks.economic_output: Approve, deny, or escalate decisions on 100 return and warranty claims with policy citation and fraud flags, accepted when audit sampling finds decisions consistent with policy
tasks.notes: Fraud false positives cost customers, false negatives cost margin; order history and policy text are the retrieved context.

tasks.name: Competitive price monitoring report (weekly, 500 SKUs)
tasks.economic_output: Weekly report of competitor prices across 500 SKUs with match confidence and repricing recommendations, accepted when the pricing lead adopts the recommendations
tasks.notes: Scraping and monitoring API access is the tool cost; product-matching errors dominate rejects.

tasks.name: Hotel guest inquiry and booking-modification handling
tasks.economic_output: Resolved email and chat inquiries including date changes, cancellations, and requests, with PMS updates made and confirmations sent, accepted at CSAT parity with human agents
tasks.notes: Support-shaped workload; PMS write access is the adoption gate and wrong modifications are the error cost.

tasks.name: Group and event RFP response for a venue
tasks.economic_output: Proposal with room block, F&B, AV pricing, and terms answering a planner's RFP, accepted when the sales manager sends it without material rework
tasks.notes: Availability and rate authority must come from the sales system; a human signs the commitment.

tasks.name: Menu engineering and description rewrite
tasks.economic_output: Item-level margin and mix analysis with pricing moves, category placement, and rewritten item copy, accepted when the operator adopts the recommendations
tasks.notes: Pricing analysis on POS mix and food cost is checkable; copy acceptance is taste-driven. Graphic design excluded.

tasks.name: Online review response for restaurants and hotels (100 reviews)
tasks.economic_output: Personalized public replies to 100 Google, TripAdvisor, and Yelp reviews with service-recovery flags, accepted after GM spot-check
tasks.notes: Among the most price-compressed tasks in the set; AI-drafted replies are already the norm on review platforms.

tasks.name: Corporate event planning proposal and run-of-show (100 guests)
tasks.economic_output: Event proposal with budget, vendor shortlist, timeline, and minute-by-minute run-of-show for a 100-guest corporate event, accepted when the client approves it for execution
tasks.notes: Deliverable is the planning document; vendor negotiation, site visits, and day-of execution are excluded and remain human.

tasks.name: Revenue-management pricing recommendation (weekly)
tasks.economic_output: Weekly rate and inventory adjustments by segment and channel from pace, pickup, and comp-set data, accepted when the GM or owner applies them
tasks.notes: RMS software already automates pricing; the priced human deliverable is the judgment overlay. Rate-shopping data is the tool cost.

tasks.name: News brief from wire and press-release inputs
tasks.economic_output: A 300-500 word house-style news brief assembled from supplied wire copy and releases, accepted when an editor publishes it with light edits and no factual insertions beyond the inputs
tasks.notes: No original reporting; the failure mode is hallucinated detail or attribution drift, both checkable against inputs.

tasks.name: Fact-check report on a draft article
tasks.economic_output: Annotated claim-by-claim report with each factual assertion verified, flagged, or unresolved against cited primary sources, accepted when the editor relies on it to clear the piece
tasks.notes: Retrieval-heavy and adversarial to confident wrong answers; source access (paywalls, phone confirmation) caps autonomy.

tasks.name: Interview transcript to 2,000-word feature draft
tasks.economic_output: A structured long-form feature draft with accurate quotes, narrative arc, and nut graf built from a 60-minute transcript, accepted when the editor takes it into normal revision rather than a rewrite
tasks.notes: Acceptance is taste-based; quote fidelity is checkable but voice and structure are where drafts get rejected.

tasks.name: Newsletter issue production
tasks.economic_output: A send-ready issue with curated links, blurbs, subject line variants, and layout copy in the publication's voice, accepted when the owner sends it with minor edits
tasks.notes: Curation quality depends on a good source feed; voice matching improves with issue history in context.

tasks.name: Headline, SEO metadata, and social copy package
tasks.economic_output: Headline options, title tag, meta description, URL slug, and 3-5 platform-specific social posts for a published article, accepted when the desk uses them without rewriting
tasks.notes: Already heavily AI-assisted in newsrooms, so the human price is compressing; character limits make part of the check deterministic.

tasks.name: Systematic-review title and abstract screening
tasks.economic_output: Include/exclude decisions with reason codes for 1,000 title-abstract records against written inclusion criteria, accepted when a sample audit shows recall of relevant studies at or near dual-reviewer level
tasks.notes: Best-evidenced task in this group (multiple LLM screening studies); missed includes are the cost, so it substitutes for one of two screeners, not both.

tasks.name: Laboratory protocol from method notes
tasks.economic_output: A reproducible step-by-step protocol with reagents, quantities, timings, controls, and safety notes written from a researcher's method notes, accepted when a second lab member can run it without asking the author
tasks.notes: Gaps in the notes must be surfaced, not filled; silent invention of a step is the disqualifying error.

tasks.name: Patent prior-art search and landscape summary
tasks.economic_output: A search report listing the closest patents and non-patent literature with relevance notes, claim-element mapping, and a landscape summary, accepted when patent counsel uses it to advise on filing
tasks.notes: Open-ended recall problem across patent databases; a patentability opinion remains attorney work and is excluded here.

tasks.name: Journal manuscript pre-submission review
tasks.economic_output: A structured review covering structure, statistics sanity, and a reporting-guideline checklist (CONSORT, STROBE, PRISMA as applicable) with prioritized revisions, accepted when the authors act on it before submission
tasks.notes: Checklist-shaped and advisory; vendors (Editage, Enago) already sell AI-assisted tiers, so the human price is compressing.

tasks.name: BI dashboard build from spec
tasks.economic_output: A working 8-10 chart dashboard on a clean warehouse with correct measures, filters, and layout per the written spec, accepted when the requesting team signs off after UAT
tasks.notes: Code-shaped where the BI tool exposes an API or code layer; GUI-only tools drop autonomy sharply.

tasks.name: Data-quality audit of a dataset
tasks.economic_output: Profiling statistics, anomaly and rule-violation findings, root-cause notes, and a prioritized remediation plan for one production dataset, accepted when the data owner adopts the plan
tasks.notes: Profiling is deterministic and cheap; the remediation plan is where judgment and business context enter.

tasks.name: Survey analysis report
tasks.economic_output: Cleaned data, weighted crosstabs, significance tests, charts, and a narrative findings report for one fielded survey, accepted when the sponsor presents it without re-analysis
tasks.notes: Stats are checkable; the narrative and what to leave out is where sponsors reject drafts.

tasks.name: A/B test analysis and readout
tasks.economic_output: Power and sample-ratio checks, effect sizes with intervals, segment sanity checks, and a ship/no-ship recommendation for one experiment, accepted when the product owner makes the decision on it
tasks.notes: Narrow, well-specified statistics with a known playbook; peeking and metric-definition errors are the traps.

tasks.name: Tier-1 SOC alert triage
tasks.economic_output: Each alert enriched, investigated, and dispositioned (escalate or close) with a written rationale a tier-2 analyst accepts
tasks.notes: AI SOC vendors already sell this at under $1/alert; false negatives on true positives are the asymmetric cost, so escalation sampling stays mandatory.

tasks.name: User-reported phishing analysis and response
tasks.economic_output: Header, URL, and attachment analysis per report with a malicious/benign verdict, containment action, and a notice back to the reporting user
tasks.notes: Narrow, high-volume, mostly benign inbox noise; detonation and URL reputation APIs are the tool cost, missed credential-phish is the risk.

tasks.name: SOC 2 evidence collection and control narratives
tasks.economic_output: Auditor-ready evidence package mapped to each control plus drafted control narratives for one audit cycle, accepted when the auditor raises no evidence gaps
tasks.notes: Compliance platforms already automate evidence pulls; narratives must match actual practice, and system access gates how much the agent can collect unattended.

tasks.name: Vendor security questionnaire response (200 questions)
tasks.economic_output: Completed SIG or CAIQ style questionnaire with accurate, evidence-backed answers in the buyer's format, accepted by the security lead for submission
tasks.notes: Answer-library retrieval is a solved pattern and AI tools already compress this price; misrepresentation risk in contracts keeps sign-off human.

tasks.name: Penetration test report from raw findings
tasks.economic_output: Client-ready report: executive summary, methodology, rated findings with evidence and reproduction steps, and prioritized remediation, accepted by the lead tester
tasks.notes: Bundled into the pentest fee, not sold separately; findings are already structured so drafting is mostly synthesis, but severity ratings need tester judgment.

tasks.name: Quarterly identity access review (20 apps)
tasks.economic_output: User-access recertification across 20 applications: entitlements collected, anomalies flagged, reviewer decisions chased, revocations verified, audit evidence packaged
tasks.notes: Bulk of the human cost is coordination and chasing managers, not analysis; IGA tooling already automates the well-integrated apps.

tasks.name: Cloud cost optimization report with implementation plan
tasks.economic_output: Rightsizing, reserved-capacity, and waste findings for one cloud account with quantified savings and a sequenced implementation plan the platform lead accepts
tasks.notes: Billing exports and utilization metrics are highly structured; savings estimates are checkable after the fact, workload context is the missing input.

tasks.name: Terraform module for a standard service (with tests)
tasks.economic_output: Reusable module with variables, outputs, docs, and passing tests that provisions a standard service pattern in a clean account
tasks.notes: Plan/apply against a sandbox is a strong verifier; provider version drift and org-specific guardrails cause most retries.

tasks.name: On-call runbook for a service
tasks.economic_output: Runbook covering alerts, diagnostics, known failure modes, and step-by-step remediation derived from incident history and architecture docs, accepted by the owning team
tasks.notes: Chronically under-produced by humans, so a low price hides real value; tacit knowledge not in incident history is what the agent cannot reach.

tasks.name: Major-version dependency upgrade PR
tasks.economic_output: Mergeable PR upgrading one library across a major version with migration changes, deprecations resolved, and the full test suite passing
tasks.notes: Already shipped as agent products (Dependabot-style plus AI fixes); behavioral changes untested by the suite are the residual risk.

tasks.name: Web accessibility audit and remediation plan (WCAG 2.2 AA, 10 pages)
tasks.economic_output: Issue inventory per page against WCAG 2.2 AA success criteria with severity, evidence, and a prioritized remediation plan, accepted by the product owner
tasks.notes: Automated checkers catch roughly a third of criteria; screen-reader and keyboard flows need a browser agent, and legal exposure keeps expert review in.

tasks.name: Log anomaly investigation write-up
tasks.economic_output: Correlated logs and metrics around an anomaly, ranked root-cause candidates with evidence, and a written summary with next steps, accepted by the service owner
tasks.notes: Lighter cousin of incident-diagnosis, no time pressure and candidates rather than a confirmed cause; observability query access is the gating dependency.

tasks.name: Adverse-event case processing (ICSR)
tasks.economic_output: Complete individual case safety report: intake, MedDRA coding, case narrative, and seriousness/expectedness assessment ready for medical review and regulatory submission
tasks.notes: 15-day expedited reporting clocks and medical-reviewer sign-off keep humans in loop; vendor AI already compressing per-case fees.

tasks.name: Protocol synopsis and plain-language summary
tasks.economic_output: Scientific protocol synopsis plus a lay-audience protocol summary (EU CTR 536/2014 PLPS style) accepted by the sponsor medical writing lead
tasks.notes: Readability targets are checkable; fidelity to protocol endpoints and eligibility criteria is the acceptance test.

tasks.name: Clinical study report section drafting (ICH E3)
tasks.economic_output: Draft of one major ICH E3 section (methods or results) written from the SAP and final TLFs with every number traceable to a table
tasks.notes: Number-to-table QC is deterministic; interpretive text and consistency across sections are where reviewers reject.

tasks.name: Regulatory submission document formatting and QC
tasks.economic_output: eCTD-ready document: template and style compliance, working hyperlinks and bookmarks, PDF properties, and a QC checklist with findings resolved
tasks.notes: eCTD validators give pass/fail on technical checks; style-guide compliance is the residual judgment call.

tasks.name: Ambient clinical note (SOAP) from visit transcript
tasks.economic_output: Structured SOAP note drafted from the visit recording and chart context, ready for clinician edit and signature in the EHR
tasks.notes: AI scribes at $39-$299/month already undercut human scribes, so V overstates durable willingness to pay.

tasks.name: Discharge summary drafting from inpatient chart
tasks.economic_output: Discharge summary with hospital course, procedures, reconciled medication list, pending results, and follow-up plan, ready for attending attestation
tasks.notes: Attending attestation is required; medication reconciliation errors are the dominant failure mode.

tasks.name: Prior-authorization denial appeal letter
tasks.economic_output: Payer-addressed appeal letter with clinical justification, guideline and literature citations, and denial-reason rebuttal, ready for physician signature
tasks.notes: Consumer AI appeal services already ship at $39.95; fabricated citations are the acceptance killer.

tasks.name: Professional resume and cover letter package
tasks.economic_output: ATS-optimized resume plus tailored cover letter for a target role, revised to client approval
tasks.notes: Heavy AI compression already in market; keyword tailoring is checkable, voice and positioning are not.

tasks.name: Individual income tax return (Form 1040 with Schedule A)
tasks.economic_output: Filing-ready federal 1040 with Schedule A and a W-2/1099 income mix, reconciled to source documents
tasks.notes: PTIN signature and e-file gates keep a preparer accountable; consumer software already automates most of the mechanics.

tasks.name: Simple will and basic estate documents
tasks.economic_output: State-conformant last will, durable financial power of attorney, and healthcare directive with execution instructions
tasks.notes: Witness and notary formalities stay physical; unauthorized-practice rules gate delivery in many states.

tasks.name: College application essay editing and coaching
tasks.economic_output: Coached and edited Common App personal statement plus two supplemental essays through multiple revision rounds, in the student's own voice
tasks.notes: Authorship and integrity policies cap substitution at editing and coaching; families still pay for a human relationship.

tasks.name: Personal debt and budget plan
tasks.economic_output: Written budget, consolidation options comparison, payoff schedule, and counseling summary the client can act on
tasks.notes: Nonprofit counseling is free at point of use, so willingness to pay is thin; coaching packages set the upper bound.

tasks.name: Home purchase document review for a buyer
tasks.economic_output: Issue memo on the purchase agreement, seller disclosures, and inspection report with contingency deadlines and recommended actions
tasks.notes: Attorney-state closings gate delivery; inspection summaries are easy, contingency-deadline advice carries the liability.

tasks.name: Crop scouting field report
tasks.economic_output: Written scouting report for one field visit: pest, weed and disease findings against economic thresholds, crop stage, field-condition map and a spray or hold recommendation, accepted when the agronomist signs it out to the grower without rework
tasks.notes: AI drafts from scout photos, notes and imagery but cannot walk the field, so the physical count stays human; R anchored below ambient-soap-note (0.88) because thresholds are regional judgment calls.

tasks.name: Farm nutrient management plan
tasks.economic_output: NRCS 590-compliant nutrient management plan for a whole farm: field-by-field manure and fertilizer rates from soil and manure tests, setbacks, application timing and records templates, accepted when a certified planner signs and the state or NRCS checklist passes
tasks.notes: Most states require a certified nutrient management planner or TSP signature, so autonomy is capped; R anchored below soc2-evidence-narratives (0.80) for multi-field, state-specific calculations.

tasks.name: USDA organic certification application package
tasks.economic_output: Complete Organic System Plan and application package for one operation: practices, inputs list with compliance checks, field histories, buffers, recordkeeping system and attachments, accepted when the certifier moves the file to inspection without a materials or completeness request
tasks.notes: Form-heavy assembly against the NOP rule and certifier templates; R anchored to nonprofit-annual-report-draft (0.78), input-material review against OMRI lists is the main failure point.

tasks.name: Nutrition Facts label compliance review
tasks.economic_output: Findings report on one retail food label against 21 CFR 101: Nutrition Facts rounding and format, serving size RACC, ingredient order, allergen statement, claims and PDP elements, each marked pass, fail or needs clarification, accepted when the regulatory reviewer adopts it without added findings
tasks.notes: Rule-check task anchored to regulatory-submission-formatting-qc (0.92) with a discount for vision-dependent format checks (type size, PDP area); the $49 to $1,295 spread is a reviewer-credential premium, not a scope difference.

tasks.name: HACCP food safety plan draft
tasks.economic_output: Codex 12-step HACCP plan for one facility: flow diagrams, hazard analysis per step, CCP determinations, critical limits, monitoring, corrective actions, verification and records, accepted when the PCQI or HACCP-trained lead adopts it for validation with only minor edits
tasks.notes: FSMA requires a Preventive Controls Qualified Individual to prepare or oversee the plan and USDA plans need HACCP-trained sign-off, so substitutability is capped; R anchored below soc2-evidence-narratives (0.80) because hazard judgments are site specific.

tasks.name: Livestock feed ration formulation
tasks.economic_output: Least-cost balanced ration for one animal group from forage tests and available ingredients: dry matter intake, energy, protein, minerals and additives against NASEM requirements with a mixing sheet and cost per head per day, accepted when the nutritionist releases it to the feeder unchanged
tasks.notes: Requirements tables and LP balancing are checkable, so R sits between nda-review (0.85) and soc2 (0.80); the market bundles formulation into feed and mineral sales, so standalone willingness to pay is thin.

tasks.name: Corporate ESG or sustainability report draft
tasks.economic_output: Full draft of an annual sustainability report mapped to GRI or SASB: materiality narrative, metrics tables reconciled to source data, targets and progress, governance and assurance-ready index, ready for design and legal review, accepted when the sustainability lead sends it to design with only copy edits
tasks.notes: R anchored below nonprofit-annual-report-draft (0.78) for framework mapping and data reconciliation across many owners; greenwashing enforcement raises the error cost above a marketing document.

tasks.name: Scope 1 and 2 greenhouse gas inventory
tasks.economic_output: GHG Protocol inventory for one reporting year: organizational and operational boundary, activity data by site, emission factors with sources, location- and market-based Scope 2, methodology memo and uncertainty notes, accepted when the reviewer or verifier raises no material recalculation
tasks.notes: Emission-factor arithmetic is checkable, so R sits near soc2-evidence-narratives (0.80) plus a few points; carbon accounting software at $3k to $15k per year is already compressing the consultant price.

tasks.name: Phase I ESA desktop records review
tasks.economic_output: Desktop portion of an ASTM E1527-21 Phase I: regulatory database report review, historical sources (aerials, Sanborn, topo, city directories), title and lien search, agency file review and a drafted findings section with candidate RECs, accepted when the Environmental Professional adopts it into the signed report
tasks.notes: ASTM E1527-21 and AAI require a licensed Environmental Professional to sign, and the site reconnaissance and interviews stay human, so only the records portion is priced; R anchored near legal-research-memo range (0.65 to 0.75).

tasks.name: CSRD disclosure gap assessment
tasks.economic_output: Gap assessment of current disclosures and data against ESRS: applicability and phase-in, preliminary double-materiality screen, datapoint-by-datapoint gap register with owners and effort, and a remediation roadmap, accepted when the sustainability lead adopts it as the implementation plan
tasks.notes: ESRS datapoint mapping is checklist-like but materiality calls are judgment; R anchored below soc2-evidence-narratives (0.80); EUR fees converted at an assumed 1.10 USD per EUR.

tasks.name: EPA Tier II chemical inventory report
tasks.economic_output: Complete EPCRA 312 Tier II submission for one facility: threshold determinations from SDS and inventory records, chemical entries with max and average daily amounts, storage codes and locations, site plan and contacts, filed in Tier2 Submit or the state portal by March 1, accepted when the EHS manager certifies without corrections
tasks.notes: Form-and-threshold task anchored to underwriting-intake (0.94) with a discount for SDS parsing and mixture rules; EPA penalties for missed chemicals run tens of thousands of dollars, so review stays with the certifying official.

tasks.name: Veterinary visit SOAP note
tasks.economic_output: Structured SOAP note from the exam-room recording and patient history: subjective history, objective findings and vitals, assessment with differentials, and plan with treatments, dispensed items and client instructions, ready for DVM edit and signature in the PIMS
tasks.notes: R anchored to ambient-soap-note (0.88) less two points for species-specific vocabulary and thinner training data; veterinary AI scribes at $50 to $250 per month already undercut human scribes, so V overstates durable willingness to pay.

tasks.name: Pet insurance claim submission package
tasks.economic_output: Complete claim package for one visit: insurer form populated from the itemized invoice and medical record, diagnosis and treatment narrative, proof of payment and attachments, submitted through the insurer portal, accepted when the claim adjudicates without a missing-information request
tasks.notes: Document-assembly task anchored to underwriting-intake (0.94) less a few points for record retrieval across PIMS and insurer portals; no pet-specific per-claim price exists, so generic claims-handling benchmarks are used.

tasks.name: Structural calculation package review
tasks.economic_output: Independent review of a structural calculation package (loads, load paths, member and connection checks, code references) against the drawings and governing code, returning an itemized findings list with recomputed checks, accepted when the reviewing PE adopts the findings and signs the review letter.
tasks.notes: Legally gated: a licensed PE must sign the review, so the AI output is a findings draft the reviewer verifies. R anchored 12 points under submittal-review (0.84) because load-path judgment and drawing reading are open-ended.

tasks.name: MEP load calculation set
tasks.economic_output: Heating and cooling loads, electrical demand load, and plumbing fixture-unit and water demand calculations for a small commercial building, tabulated by zone or panel from the architectural set and code tables, accepted when the engineer of record adopts the numbers for equipment sizing and stamps the set.
tasks.notes: Legally gated: PE stamp required on the permit set. R anchored 5 points under quantity-takeoff-estimate (0.75); the arithmetic is deterministic but envelope and occupancy extraction from plan sheets is vision-heavy.

tasks.name: CAD drawing set QC markup
tasks.economic_output: Redlined QC markup of a construction drawing set checking sheet index, title blocks, callouts and detail references, dimension strings, grid and level consistency, and cross-discipline clashes, with a numbered comment log, accepted when the project lead adopts the log for revision without adding material misses.
tasks.notes: Reference and dimension checks are deterministic and checkable; R anchored 7 points under bom-validation-costing (0.85) for the vision load of reading sheets.

tasks.name: As-built drawing update
tasks.economic_output: Record drawing set produced by transferring contractor redlines, RFIs and change orders into the CAD or BIM sheets, with a revision log and clouded changes, accepted when the architect issues the set as record documents.
tasks.notes: Priced as drafting from redlines, no field capture. Requires driving CAD or BIM tooling, which caps autonomy; R sits under cad-drawing-qc-markup (0.78) because the output is edited geometry, not a comment log.

tasks.name: Zoning and entitlement analysis report
tasks.economic_output: Report for one parcel stating zoning district and overlays, permitted and conditional uses, dimensional standards (setbacks, height, FAR, lot coverage, parking), nonconformities, and the entitlement path with approvals required, accepted when the developer or land-use counsel relies on it for a go or no-go decision.
tasks.notes: Code retrieval is narrow but interpretation of overlays and pending amendments is judgment-heavy; R between legal-research-memo (0.65) and nda-review (0.85). Zoneomics already sells AI-assembled briefs at $39 to $65, so price is compressing.

tasks.name: CSI specification section draft
tasks.economic_output: Three-part CSI MasterFormat specification section (General, Products, Execution) edited from a master or written for a named product scope, coordinated with the drawings and referenced standards, accepted when the specifier or architect issues it in the project manual with only editorial changes.
tasks.notes: Template-driven editing of master text; R anchored 5 points under nda-review (0.85) for product-standard currency risk. Review role engineer stands in for the architect or specifier.

tasks.name: Residential HVAC Manual J load calculation
tasks.economic_output: ACCA Manual J room-by-room heat loss and heat gain report for one home from plans or field measurements, with design conditions, envelope inputs and equipment sizing summary, accepted when the permit office or HVAC contractor uses it to size equipment without rework.
tasks.notes: Calculation runs in Wrightsoft or CoolCalc; the limiter is extracting envelope inputs from plans. Market is already compressed to $79 to $250 flat by online services, so V overstates durable willingness to pay.

tasks.name: Home inspection report
tasks.economic_output: Written home inspection report assembled from the inspector's field notes and photos: captioned defect photos, narrative comments by system, severity flags and a summary of safety and major items, accepted when the licensed inspector signs and delivers it without material edits.
tasks.notes: Legally gated: the site visit and signature belong to a licensed inspector, so only the report-writing deliverable is priced. R anchored near submittal-review (0.84) less 9 points for photo interpretation and liability language.

tasks.name: Roofing estimate from aerial measurement
tasks.economic_output: Itemized residential roof replacement estimate built from an aerial measurement report (EagleView, Hover or similar): squares, waste factor, pitch, flashing and accessory counts, material and labor pricing and a customer-ready proposal, accepted when the estimator sends it to the homeowner without repricing.
tasks.notes: Tool cost is the aerial report itself ($40 to $75 per roof). Measurements arrive structured, so R sits 7 points above quantity-takeoff-estimate (0.75); AI measurement vendors already sell $10 reports.

tasks.name: Plumbing repair estimate
tasks.economic_output: Written repair estimate for a residential plumbing job from the technician's diagnosis notes and photos: scope, parts list, flat-rate or time-and-material pricing, options and exclusions, accepted when the homeowner can approve it without a follow-up visit or repricing.
tasks.notes: Diagnosis requires the truck roll; only the estimate write-up is priced. Flat-rate price-book software already compresses this, and the fee is usually credited toward the repair.

tasks.name: Residential landscape design plan
tasks.economic_output: Scaled residential landscape plan with hardscape layout, planting plan and plant schedule, material list and a rendered view, sized to the lot and climate zone, accepted when the homeowner approves it for installation bids.
tasks.notes: Creative deliverable judged by taste, so R sits in the general-knowledge band (0.50 to 0.70); scaled drawing output needs CAD or image tooling.

tasks.name: Contractor bid proposal package
tasks.economic_output: Complete bid package for a residential or light commercial contractor: scope narrative, quantity takeoff, unit-priced estimate with markup, inclusions and exclusions, schedule and terms, accepted when the contractor submits it without re-estimating.
tasks.notes: R anchored to quantity-takeoff-estimate (0.75); the proposal wrapper is easy, the takeoff from plan sheets is the limiter. Offshore estimating firms already price bids at $250 to $2,500.

tasks.name: DOT driver qualification file audit
tasks.economic_output: Audited 49 CFR 391 driver qualification file: every required document (application, MVRs, medical certificate, road test, prior-employer inquiries, annual review) verified present, current and internally consistent, with a dated remediation list; accepted when a safety manager signs it off as audit-ready.
tasks.notes: Checklist against a fixed regulation; R anchored to vendor-onboarding (0.88), slightly higher since the required-document list is closed. FMCSA fines average $5,959 per violation drive the risk term.

tasks.name: IFTA quarterly fuel tax filing
tasks.economic_output: Filed IFTA quarterly return for a small fleet: per-jurisdiction miles and gallons reconciled from ELD trip data and fuel receipts, tax or credit computed per jurisdiction, return submitted to the base jurisdiction with audit-ready schedules.
tasks.notes: Arithmetic is deterministic once mileage and fuel data reconcile; missing receipts and unassigned miles are the failure mode. R anchored to po-processing (0.95) minus 5 points for reconciliation gaps. Small-fleet market, per-quarter unit.

tasks.name: Fleet daily route plan
tasks.economic_output: One day's route plan for a small fleet: stop sequencing, driver and vehicle assignment, customer time windows and HOS limits honored, deadhead and ETA summary issued to drivers; accepted when the dispatcher releases it without rework.
tasks.notes: Software-assisted (route optimization APIs do the solving); acceptance is graded by on-time and miles outcomes with a lag. R anchored to inventory-forecast (0.75) plus 3 points because constraints are checkable up front.

tasks.name: Freight cargo loss and damage claim filing
tasks.economic_output: Complete Carmack-compliant loss or damage claim packet: BOL, POD with noted exceptions, commercial invoice, photos, itemized claimed amount and mitigation statement, filed with the carrier inside the 9-month window and tracked to acknowledgment; accepted when the carrier acknowledges without a documentation deficiency.
tasks.notes: Document assembly against carrier and Carmack requirements; R anchored to vendor-onboarding (0.88). Recovery outcome depends on liability facts, not on the filing, so acceptance is the deficiency-free filing.

tasks.name: Hours-of-service ELD log violation review
tasks.economic_output: Audit of 100 driver daily logs: 11, 14 and 60/70-hour and 30-minute-break violations, form-and-manner errors, unassigned driving and suspicious edits flagged against fuel and toll receipts, with per-driver reports and corrective recommendations.
tasks.notes: Rules are fixed and ELD data is structured; R anchored to underwriting-intake (0.94) minus 2 points for the receipt cross-check. Vendors price per driver per month, converted here at ~22 logs per driver-month.

tasks.name: Customs entry (CBP Form 7501) filing
tasks.economic_output: Entry summary (CBP 7501) prepared for a formal entry: HTS lines, entered values, MPF and HMF, PGA flags, bond reference and commercial documents reconciled, ready for licensed-broker review and ABI transmission; accepted when the broker files it without correction.
tasks.notes: Legal gate: transacting customs business for others requires a licensed customs broker (19 CFR 111), so the AI prepares and the broker signs and transmits. R anchored to po-processing (0.95) minus 7 for multi-document reconciliation and classification dependency.

tasks.name: HTS tariff classification ruling
tasks.economic_output: Defended 10-digit HTSUS classification for one SKU: GRI order-of-review analysis, competing headings ruled out, duty rate, trade-remedy and PGA flags, with CROSS ruling citations; accepted when a licensed broker or trade counsel adopts it for entry.
tasks.notes: Judgment-heavy with binding-ruling and penalty exposure; R anchored to medical-coding (0.70) minus 5 for composite-goods and essential-character calls. AI classification tools at $2-15 per SKU are already compressing this market.

tasks.name: Importer Security Filing (ISF 10+2)
